user.title: Ingress account cookie
user.description: Log in to https://intel.ingress.com in your browser, open the developer tools → Network tab, click any request to intel.ingress.com, and copy the full value of the `Cookie` request header. It must contain `csrftoken=`.

region.title: Add a region
region.description: Enter a coordinate inside the region you want to monitor, as decimal `lat, lng` (e.g. `51.39011, 8.583748`). Tip: pan the intel map to your area and copy the `ll=` value from the URL. Optionally give the region a custom name.

confirm.title: Confirm region
confirm.description: This coordinate resolves to region **{region_name}**. Submit to finish setup.

reauth_confirm.title: Update cookie
reauth_confirm.description: Your Ingress cookie has expired or become invalid. Paste a fresh `Cookie` header from a logged-in intel.ingress.com request.

error.invalid_cookie: The cookie does not contain a csrftoken value.
error.invalid_auth: The cookie is invalid or expired — log in again and copy a fresh one.
error.invalid_coordinates: Could not parse the coordinates. Use decimal `lat, lng`.
error.region_exists: That region is already being monitored.

add_region.title: Add a region
add_region.description: Enter a coordinate inside the region as decimal `lat, lng`.

add_confirm.title: Confirm region
add_confirm.description: This coordinate resolves to region **{region_name}**. Submit to add it.

abort.no_regions: There are no regions to remove.
